description: Malawi Flood Response Round 1 - Site assessment is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by International Organization for Migration (IOM). Site Assessment conducted as the response to internal displacement due to Floods in 2015. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher International Organization for Migration (IOM). Its tags are flooding, internally displaced persons-idp, natural disasters, populated places-settlements. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2024-12-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-IGO-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
